/value/1/description.value: Gains #1 Privilege Weapon Box(es) at the start of the Second Plane.

/value/10/description.value: All Investment Strategies in this round are of Gold quality.

/value/11/description.value: All Investment Strategies in this round are of Silver quality, so enemy difficulty will not increase with selecting higher quality Investment Strategies.

/value/12/description.value: Enter a random investment environment and gain #1 Gold Coin(s) at the start.

/value/13/description.value: At the start of each preparation phase, the drop rate for characters of a random cost is doubled. This is re-randomized in every preparation phase.

/value/14/description.value: Obtain a Peppy wearing three random emblems.

/value/15/description.value: Gets a Peppy wearing three random Emblems. The clumsy Peppy sometimes drops Emblems in your inventory.

/value/16/description.value: All Combat Nodes in the Third Plane are replaced with Encounter Nodes.

/value/17/description.value: Gain a random emblem. Each time you enter a Boss Node, receive a random character with the corresponding Bond.

/value/18/description.value: All reward nodes in this game are replaced with a Super Warp Trotter theme! They drop tons of treasure, but they run super fast!

/value/19/description.value: After refreshing #1 time(s) by spending Gold Coins, receives #2 Gold Coins. Afterwards, refreshing only costs 1 Gold Coin in this run.

/value/2/description.value: Gains a crystal ore worth #1/#2/#3 Gold Coin(s) at the start of Plane 1/2/3 respectively.

/value/20/description.value: 2-star characters may appear in the Store.

/value/21/description.value: At Node 2-6, gain an additional choice and choose one of three Investment Strategies.

/value/22/description.value: The first investment strategy is of Prismatic quality.

/value/23/description.value: The third investment strategy is of Prismatic quality.

/value/24/description.value: When ranking up Sparkle's and Tribbie's star rating, randomly obtains <color=#927fe7>"Fu Xuan"</color> or <color=#7196ff>"Seele"</color>.

/value/25/description.value: Obtains <color=#b4b4b4>"Jade"</color> and <color=#6cce9f>"Aventurine"</color>. After gaining a total interest of <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak>, obtains <color=#ffd471>"Topaz & Numby"</color>.

/value/26/description.value: Obtains <color=#b4b4b4>"Jiaoqiu"</color> and <color=#6cce9f>"Kafka"</color>. When an enemy is defeated, gains 1 tally for each different DoT state inflicted. When the tally reaches <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak>, obtains <color=#ffd471>"Black Swan"</color>.

/value/27/description.value: Obtain <color=#6cce9f>"Dan Heng • Imbibitor Lunae"</color> and <color=#6cce9f>"Sparkle"</color>. After opening #1 crystal ore(s), obtain <color=#927fe7>"Sparxie"</color> and 1 random Skill Point Bond character. Afterward, repeating the character reward for every #2 crystal ore(s) opened.

/value/28/description.value: Obtain <color=#6cce9f>"Kafka"</color>. After <color=#b4b4b4>"Blade"</color> or <color=#6cce9f>"Mortenax Blade"</color>, <color=#6cce9f>"Kafka"</color>, and <color=#7196ff>"Silver Wolf LV.<unbreak>999</unbreak>"</color> or <color=#927fe7>"Silver Wolf"</color> fight together in a battle, obtain <color=#ffd471>"Firefly"</color> who can only be deployed after #1 Node(s).

/value/29/description.value: Starts with a "Red Gem" and a "Basic Weapon Box."

/value/3/description.value: Obtain a "Wealth Gem" upon achieving the first #1-win streak in this round.

/value/30/description.value: Starts with a "Blue Gem" and a "Basic Weapon Box."

/value/31/description.value: Obtains a 2-star <color=#ffd471>5-cost character</color> that can be deployed after #1 Node(s). After a perfect victory in combat, deployment Node additionally advances by 1.

/value/31/remarks/0.value: Appearing Hero: [Current value]\nRemaining Nodes Before Appearance: [Current value]

/value/32/description.value: Immediately receives a "Surprise Box." The present opens after #1 Node(s). After a perfect victory in combat, additionally reduces the countdown by 1.

/value/33/description.value: In this round, when selecting Investment Strategies at fixed Nodes, the left, middle, and right options will be Silver, Gold, and Prismatic quality respectively, and Investment Strategy refresh count increases by #1.

/value/34/description.value: Get 1 random #1-star 1-cost damage-dealing character. When entering a new Node, this character permanently gains a random stat bonus.

/value/35/description.value: Get 1 random #1-star <color=#6cce9f>2-cost character</color>. When entering a new Node, this character permanently gains a random stat bonus.

/value/36/description.value: After reaching level #1, gains #3 Experience when entering the next #2 Node(s).

/value/38/description.value: Obtains Expert Advisor <color=#b4b4b4>"Tingyun"</color> and add her to the Store for this run. When Tingyun uses her Ultimate, the target teammate gains On-Field Strength equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of Tingyun's Off-Field Strength. This effect only applies to the most recent target teammate.

/value/39/description.value: Obtains Expert Advisor <color=#b4b4b4>Gallagher</color> and add him to the Store for this run. Activate 2/4/6/9 Break Bond to receive #1 "Aether Drill."

/value/4/description.value: All reward nodes in this game are replaced with a Warp Trotter theme. Warp Trotters will drop more loot.

/value/40/description.value: When you first obtain <color=#7196ff>"Silver Wolf LV.<unbreak>999</unbreak>"</color>, gains the Expert Advisor <color=#927fe7>"Silver Wolf"</color> and add her to the Store for this run.

/value/41/description.value: Starting supplies are replaced with 3 random <color=#7196ff>3-cost characters</color>. When a <color=#7196ff>3-cost character's</color> star rating upgrades to 2/3, gain <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>/<unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> SPD Amplification and <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak>/<unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak> DMG Amplification.

/value/42/description.value: When entering a new Node, all characters on the field gain <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> On/Off-Field Strength and <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> DMG Mitigation. This effect is stackable.

/value/43/description.value: Start with disabling one enemy's affixes that have already spawned. Disabled this run: [Current value]

/value/44/description.value: When obtaining an Investment Strategy, gain (<unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> × current number of Investment Strategies owned) Gold Coins. At Node 3-5, gain an additional Investment Strategy.

/value/45/description.value: Obtain Expert Advisor <color=#b4b4b4>"Sampo"</color> and add him to the Store for this run. Every time you enter a new Node, good ol' Sampo will bring you a little gift! The higher <color=#b4b4b4>"Sampo's"</color> star rating when he enters the fray, the better the gift!

/value/46/description.value: Start with "Follow-Up ATK" character and basic equipment. Increased drop rate of "Follow-Up ATK" characters.

/value/47/description.value: Gains a "Bloodflame" character and basic equipment when the round starts. Drop rate for "Bloodflame" characters is increased.

/value/48/description.value: Start with "Energy" character and basic equipment. Increased drop rate of "Energy" characters.

/value/49/description.value: Start with "Express Cohort" character and basic equipment. Increased drop rate of "Express Cohort" characters.

/value/5/description.value: After the Store refreshes #1 time(s), obtain #2 Gold Coin(s) and a "Staff Projector."

/value/50/description.value: Start with "Cosmic Scholar" character and basic equipment. Increased drop rate of "Cosmic Scholar" characters.

/value/51/description.value: Start with "Belobog" character and basic equipment. Increased drop rate of "Belobog" characters.

/value/52/description.value: Start with "Galactic Voyager" character and basic equipment. Increased drop rate of "Galactic Voyager" characters.

/value/53/description.value: Gains a "Xianzhou" character and initial basic equipment when the round starts. Drop rate for "Xianzhou" characters is increased.

/value/54/description.value: Start with "Wolf Hunt" character and basic equipment. Increased drop rate of "Wolf Hunt" characters.

/value/55/description.value: Start with "Day Demigod" character and basic equipment. Increased drop rate of "Day Demigod" characters.

/value/56/description.value: Start with "Night Demigod" character and basic equipment. Increased drop rate of "Night Demigod" characters.

/value/57/description.value: Start with "Break" character and basic equipment. Increased drop rate of "Break" characters.

/value/58/description.value: Start with "AoE ATK" character and basic equipment. Increased drop rate of "AoE ATK" characters.

/value/59/description.value: Start with "Debuff" character and basic equipment. Increased drop rate of "Debuff" characters.

/value/6/description.value: An extra supply phase is added before every Boss Node.

/value/60/description.value: Start with "Skill Point" character and basic equipment. Increased drop rate of "Skill Point" characters.

/value/7/description.value: In supply phases, characters will carry two items.

/value/81/description.value: Gains "Silver Wolf LV.<unbreak>999</unbreak>". Each time she triggers the Independent Bond option "Top Player", gains <color=#927fe7>"Sparxie"</color> or <color=#927fe7>"Trailblazer: Elation"</color>.

/value/82/description.value: Obtain <color=#b4b4b4>"Rin Tohsaka"</color> and <color=#6cce9f>"Gilgamesh"</color>, then complete the Holy Grail trial twice to obtain <color=#ffd471>"Archer"</color>.

/value/9/description.value: All Investment Strategies in this round are of Prismatic quality.
